in_sanskrit.name: काशी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Kasi' in Sanskrit is derived from the word 'Ksetra' meaning 'field' or 'plot of ground'. The city of Kasi is also known as Varanasi or Banaras. It is one of the seven sacred cities for Hindus. The city is believed to be the place where one can attain salvation and reach Moksha (liberation from the cycle of birth and death).

in_tamil.name: காசி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name 'Kasi' in Tamil is derived from the Tamil word 'Aruththam' meaning 'auspicious'. The city of Kasi is also known as Kasi Malai or Tiruvanaikka. It is one of the 275 Jyotirlingas and is considered a sacred place for Shaivites. The city is believed to have the power to purify the soul and grant the devotee's wishes.
